data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 现代街头的女神考察·「人类的甜甜圈……是供品吗」
data.description: 【现代都市街头·午后】牛仔外套与白色短上衣搭配高腰短裤，伊什塔尔举起吃了一半的甜甜圈，眼睛亮得像发现了宝藏。今天王冠换成星形发夹，她边走边得意地宣布，下一份考察清单还要多加几种甜点。
data.action: 举甜甜圈眼睛发亮，牛仔外套短上衣，边走边咬
data.camera: medium shot, street walking, donut in hand, cheerful mood
data.promptProse: Walking the afternoon street, Ishtar raises a half-eaten donut toward the viewer and gestures enthusiastically with her free hand, red eyes delighted by the dessert. Denim jacket, white crop tee, high-waisted shorts and sneakers retain her modern outfit beneath the star-shaped hairpin. The medium view follows storefronts along her route. Bright afternoon light and shop-window reflections catch the hoop earrings and donut glaze, leaving soft shade beneath the jacket collar.
